offering_description.value: Designs and manufactures commercial laundry equipment such as washers and dryers for laundromats, multi-housing facilities and on-premises laundries, plus residential laundry appliances. Sells mainly through distributors and supplies parts.

primary_products.value: commercial washers; commercial dryers; residential washers and dryers; ironers and finishing equipment; replacement parts

customer_segment.value: B2B: laundromat owners, route operators for apartments and dorms, hotels, healthcare and institutional laundries; B2C: households buying residential laundry appliances

end_markets.value: laundromats; multi-housing; hospitality; healthcare; education and institutions; residential appliances

revenue_model.value: product sales: washers, dryers and related equipment sold to distributors and customers; product sales: replacement parts and accessories

value_chain_position.value: OEM / manufacturer: builds laundry equipment from purchased components and materials, sold to distributors, operators and retailers; brand owner: owns laundry equipment brands marketed to commercial and residential customers

geography_served.value: global: North America primary, with sales to Europe, Asia, Latin America and other regions

specialization.value: related lines: commercial laundry equipment, residential laundry appliances and parts

distribution_channels.value: distributors / dealers: independent laundry equipment distributors serving laundromats and route operators; third-party retail: retailers selling residential laundry appliances; direct sales: national accounts and large institutional customers
distribution_channels.category: distributors / dealers; third-party retail; direct sales

regulatory_exposure.value: medium: appliance energy and water efficiency standards (US DOE), product safety and environmental rules
